findings.title: SEP-10 middleware is wired with an issuer that may be empty, so issuer and service binding are skipped
Any registered phone or email identity can delete the whole account registration
Firebase ID tokens are not checked for revocation
Sign route never checks time bounds, so the service signature on a transaction never expires
SEP-10 issuer check is skipped when no issuer is configured, and the token is not bound to this service
Auth method values are never validated, so identities can be stored in a form that never matches a login

failing_checks.title: Raw byte signing
failing_checks.reason: The bytes signed are the hash of a transaction the requester supplied (tx.Hash() of req.Transaction at line 130). The agent key therefore acts as a signing oracle for any transaction the requester builds that passes the source check. Input is not limited to a fixed-structure preimage or a transactio

failing_checks.title: Expiry and fees
failing_checks.reason: The handler never reads tx.Timebounds, so a signed envelope can carry timeout 0 (no expiry) and remain valid indefinitely. The fee (tx.Fee, from input) is also not bounded: the handler signs whatever fee the requester set, and the account pays it. The earlier finding covers the missing expiry.
